notes.title: Let's Go Nuts 2 is NOW LIVE on Steam 🐿️
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The moment you’ve been [i]nuts[/i] about is here—[b]Let’s Go Nuts 2 is live on Steam with 40% OFF![/b]

Our squirrel hero was this close to retirement, but nooo, some bear had to go full thief mode and steal his stash. Now it’s chase time across wild 3D worlds. Will you catch the bear, or will he just keep roasting you? Go find out.  🐿️💨
